title: AS SIMPLE AS FINE-TUNING: LLM ALIGNMENT VIA BIDIRECTIONAL NEGATIVE FEEDBACK LOSS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and technical analysis of a novel alignment loss function (BNF). While it mentions 'value alignment' as a goal, the evaluation is performed on standard reasoning and QA benchmarks (Wild-Bench, Arena-Hard, GSM8K, MATH, CRUX, MMLU) without a specific focus on religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
